operator_instruction: Run the one-command go/no-go script before accepting any first-real-drop file.
Accept files only into quarantine/intake lanes; never directly into release or closure lanes.
Reject public notices, public meeting statements, AAR paragraphs, PI pages, dashboards, or MSEL rows offered as closure.
claim_boundary: public context can route or reopen only

operator_instruction: For each packet require original hash, redacted surrogate or sensitive-annex reason, custody event, owner, verifier, source clock, and counterevidence path.
If the console, network, scanner, or identity system fails, use offline packet forms and keep the loss cap active.
Run media quarantine before opening or copying external media.
claim_boundary: scan pass is not readiness proof

operator_instruction: Keep synthetic dry-run artifacts separate; retire or replace them before adjudication.
claim_boundary: synthetic payloads never count as real evidence

operator_instruction: Use the safe public statement draft; do not write ready, green, passed, safe, certified, sufficient, demonstrated, or closed.
Escalate any hash, timestamp, custody, surrogate, or fork conflict to the repair board.
A candidate packet moves to adjudication only; CAP/retest/verifier and claim-kernel gates control any future claim.
